title: Today's top stories in 60 seconds

slides.headline: Today's top stories in 60 seconds
slides.subtitle: Get caught up on the day's biggest news without the noise.

slides.headline: New strikes hit Russia and Ukraine
slides.explanation: Recent attacks on both sides have left 14 people dead. Ukraine is now warning that it is running low on critical missile defense interceptors.

slides.headline: Oil prices dip after Iran update
slides.explanation: Global oil prices fell after President Trump said he would hold off on new strikes against Iran. This suggests a potential easing of immediate tensions in the region.

slides.headline: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja passes away
slides.explanation: The world-renowned climber died following an avalanche in Pakistan. He famously set a record by summiting all 14 of the world's highest peaks in just over six months.

slides.headline: Senate reaches deal to avoid shutdown
slides.explanation: Lawmakers have agreed on a spending bill to keep federal agencies running through the midterm elections. This move prevents a government shutdown until early December.

slides.headline: Trump's Iran strategy faces scrutiny
slides.explanation: While President Trump often announces he is halting strikes in Iran, military actions continue to occur. This pattern raises questions about the effectiveness of current foreign policy communication.

caption:
From the latest in global conflicts to major changes in Washington, here is what you need to know today. We break down the facts so you can stay informed without the clutter. Which of these updates surprised you the most?

slides.subtitle: Catch up on the five biggest headlines you need to know today.

slides.headline: What to stream in August
slides.explanation: New seasons of Ted Lasso, Reacher, and Outer Banks are hitting screens this month. It is the perfect time to update your watch list.

slides.headline: Amazon boosts S&P 500 earnings
slides.explanation: Amazon just reported massive profit growth largely due to its investment in Anthropic. This move is helping drive the broader market higher.

slides.headline: Ukrainian drones strike in Russia
slides.explanation: Ukrainian drones hit a Wildberries warehouse and caused eight deaths, according to regional governors. The conflict continues to have serious consequences on the ground.

slides.headline: The budget laptop wars are on
slides.explanation: Apple is finding success with its cheaper MacBook Neo model. This shift is forcing other laptop makers to change their strategy to compete.

slides.headline: Bank stocks are rallying
slides.explanation: Investors are moving money into financial stocks this month. The Federal Reserve's upcoming decisions will likely decide if this trend keeps going.
